title: Teacher Bai's Friend NFT Card Game
tagline: An Awesome NFT Card Game for Teacher Bai's Friend XiaoShan Cat.
description:
This project Create a NFT Card Game for Xiao Shan NFT on polygon Mumbai Network. 



Try in the live site: https://xiaoshan-card-game-fi.vercel.app/



Xiao Shan NFT is a female kitten cat that's Teacher Bai's best friend. Our motivation is create a new home for her in Web3, and let everyone enjoy her there! This is a most Futuristic Hack to interact with Teacher Bai's friend and play with Xiao Shan cat in this XiaoShan NFT Card Game. Mint an NFT, Get a unique Card, Play with Xiao Shan - Teacher Bai's Friend! You can memorize your interactions and activities with Xiao Shan Cat, feed, groom, pet Xiao Shan Cat and Xiao Shan's friends in different places, and go to different places with Xiao Shan, enjoy the unique experience, and have fun in this Card Game!



Q & A:

1. Who is Teacher Bai?

Teacher Bai is a Software Engineer at 🐶. Also a solo artist(https://xb52.myportfolio.com). Teacher Bai love to hack stuff and is curious about Blockchain/Metaverse technology!



2. Who is Xiao Shan?

Xiao Shan is a cute kitten of Teacher Bai, has a great reputation among Teacher Bai's friends. Teacher Bai makes a YouTube playlist(https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyhupzpahLTYXjiHtCpnlyDx5Wm3jnzwV) to keep Xiao Shan's like updates in the metaverse ecosystem(future design).
how_its_made: This project uses polygon Mumbai network to mint Xiao Shan NFT, and created a Web3 based Card game using React Redux, JavaScript and HTML5/CSS. We did use own drawing skills to make 1200+ NFTs for Xiao Shan - our kitten cat. We used the above technologies to create a new home for her in Web3, and let everyone enjoy her there!  This project need to use Metamask wallet. I deployed and verifyed my own smart contract on Remix publish my own NFT using Opensea API, also developed a minting Dapp & Card Game Dapp using react redux. Plus, this project created avatars based on my cute cat Xiao Shan. Almost all NFTs are based on stories we had!
